note: `duplicates` groups the names OWN-exported by >=2 'src' files, by name only, with no classification. `runtime` and `types` hold depgraph's classified lists of the same kind of names (see classificationNote); only TRUE_DUPLICATE entries there are merge targets.
classificationNote: This report groups names by OWN definition, not by call graph, then classifies each flagged name (see DupEntryTag): TRUE_DUPLICATE (the actionable merge targets), DISPATCH_VARIANT (>=2 mathTyped(...) registrations of the same public name — distinct dispatch surfaces, not copy-paste bodies), ALIAS_DELEGATION (a const-alias forward to an imported symbol, not an independent body — excluded once fewer than 2 real bodies remain), and ALLOWLISTED (matches duplicate-allowlist.json: for example hot-path is* guards, mirrors in another language, per-package VERSION strings). NOT detected: same-file typed-dispatch overload polymorphism for different argument shapes within one registration — a human still triages TRUE_DUPLICATE entries using the defining files + public flags before merging anything.

definers.reason: Each name is a renderer wrapper in src/platform/index.ts. The wrapper calls an IPC channel of the main process. A function of the same name sits on the other side of that channel, in core/ or in electron/. The renderer imports no runtime module of core, only the types in core/types. The two definitions are the two sides of the IPC boundary, not a copy.
